conversation.text: As Xueyu whispers and releases her hand, the moment Suncan falls into the shadow, the light in the Hakugyokurou courtyard seems completely drained. The jade tiles beneath everyone's feet vanish, replaced by an endless, churning plane of pure black, as if connected to some greedy stomach. Upon this pure darkness, countless blood-red eyes suddenly open. They are densely packed, like spores of a plague, their pupils uniformly locking onto Yuyuko. Then, beneath the eyes, they split open—countless giant mouths filled with sharp teeth, constantly opening and closing, chewing! They layer upon layer, transforming into waves of crimson tide, silently yet violently surging towards the central Princess of Spirits. And Xueyu's figure has completely merged into this hungry darkness. The instant the deathly mouths are about to touch their target— "Let's start biting... from here!" A roar erupts from a suddenly gaping giant mouth right below Yuyuko! Xueyu shoots out like a stalking predator. The originally heavy Saw Cleaver now feels weightless in her hands, wildly swung with a frenzied posture. Each slash heavily strikes the surrounding dark tide! With each swing, grating chewing sounds come from the blade, and the surging tide of mouths also contracts, condenses, as if being voraciously "eaten" and absorbed by the Saw Cleaver. "Next is... digestion!" A distorted, fanatical smile blooms on Xueyu's face. When the last bit of the dark tide is completely sucked into the blade, the Saw Cleaver has utterly transformed into a boiling, ominous deep red. It carries an insatiable hunger, an absolute will to devour everything, and slashes down towards the barrier! Crack—! A clear, sharp shattering sound rings out. On the sturdy barrier constructed from Saigyou Ayakashi petals and the laws of the Netherworld, a vicious crack appears in response!
